name: 17059 · Mifflintown, PA
findings: ZIP 17059 (Mifflintown) has 49 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 17059 (Mifflintown) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
39% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
